expectations.text: The h1 reaches at least 2 times its size by 500% browser zoom on a 1280px window (size at a 256px viewport times 5, against 1280px)
The h1 grows at least 1.6 times at 200% browser zoom on a 1280px window (this project's house bar; WCAG 1.4.4 sets no ratio)
The h1 is between 38.4 and 57.6px at a 360px viewport and between 64 and 96px at a 1440px viewport (the requested sizes, within 20%)
